task.instruction: Search for one-way flights from New York to London on Dec. 26th and filter the results to show only non-stop flights.

final_answer:
Done — I searched one-way flights from New York to London departing Saturday, Dec. 26, 2026, and applied the Nonstop filter. Google Flights returned **23 nonstop results**, ranging from **$432 to $1,124** (prices include taxes and fees for 1 adult, Economy).

**Top flights (best price/convenience balance):**
- **$432** — 10:20 PM JFK → 10:30 AM+1 LHR, Delta / KLM / Virgin Atlantic, 7h 10m
- **$432** — 11:20 PM JFK → 11:10 AM+1 LHR, British Airways / American / Iberia / Finnair / Alaska, 6h 50m (fastest of the cheapest pair)
- **$582** — 7:01 PM JFK → 7:15 AM+1 LHR, Virgin Atlantic / Air France / Delta / KLM, 7h 14m

**Cheapest of the remaining nonstop options:**
- **$463** — 6:10 PM JFK → 6:15 AM+1 LHR, British Airways (7h 5m)
- **$463** — 6:40 PM JFK → 6:40 AM+1 LHR, British Airways (7h)
- **$483** — 6:30 PM EWR → 6:30 AM+1 LHR, British Airways (7h)
- **$511** — 8:00 PM JFK → 8:05 AM+1 LHR, Delta / KLM / Virgin Atlantic (7h 5m)

**Higher-priced nonstop options** include several Virgin Atlantic departures at $582–$678, British Airways at $674–$681, United out of Newark at $710–$772, JetBlue at $944 (9:30 AM JFK → 9:40 PM LHR, 7h 10m), and JetBlue/TAP at $1,124.

All flights depart the New York area from either JFK or Newark (EWR) and arrive at London Heathrow (LHR), with flight times between 6h 50m and 7h 27m. The page notes prices are currently "typical" for this route and date.
